frontier.hypothesis: If the function is ever re-opened, the ONE remaining unnamed link is the cse canonicalisation rule behind E-s16-2: why a downstream re-definition of reg79 changes which member of the reg79/reg80 equivalence class cse names at the UPSTREAM base add (insn 89). Naming it would turn every loop-2 preheader spelling from a blind guess into a checkable predicate. It is banked as UNRESOLVED, not as a live lever, because s17 proved that even a confirmed predicate has no affordable C carrier.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c canonicalises a register operand to qty_first_reg[reg_qty[regno]] (canon_reg); qty_first_reg can MOVE when a class member is invalidated (delete_reg_equiv / invalidate), and insert / merge_equiv_classes decides membership order. The candidate's tail `p = q;` and cell E2's tail `p = *(u8 **)(ctx + 0xC);` differ only in whether reg79 is re-set from a class member or from a MEM.
frontier.next_probe: Add a BB2_CSE_DEBUG trace in canon_reg / insert / merge_equiv_classes / invalidate printing (insn uid, regno, reg_qty, qty_first_reg) for pseudos in the 72-120 range, rebuild ONLY tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 (never build/cc1), re-prove codegen identity with tmp/grind/func_80017848/s16/idump.sh, and diff the candidate's trace against cell E2's at insn 83 and insn 89.

frontier.hypothesis: The residual's 3 instructions may be reachable only by a whole-function chassis that no session has authored - one derived from a different source-level decomposition of the two scan loops rather than from mutations of the s8/s9 lineage. Every chassis measured to date descends from that single lineage plus the s14 m2c-derived N1 variant.
frontier.mechanism: The candidate's 3 residual instructions sit at the seam between loop 1's exit tail and loop 2's preheader, and s17's P7/P8 show that spelling that seam the way target's asm reads costs 12. That is the signature of a chassis-relative optimum: the whole surrounding shape, not the seam, is what fixes cse's equivalence classes at the seam.
frontier.next_probe: Re-derive the function from asm with m2c under a different structuring configuration than s14's N1, take the FIRST compilable output without hand-tuning, score it, and only then apply the ledger's individually-measured levers. If the raw re-derivation is worse than 12 the lineage question is settled negatively and this frontier closes too.
